mentions.name: WhimPop
mentions.description: A Mac launcher that appears when holding down the right-click button (the regular context menu still shows on a single click). It offers a rail of favorite apps, folders, and URLs, plus clipboard history, text snippets, a timer, and more.
mentions.source_excerpt: Another app I've made is called WhimPop and it's a launcher that's shown when you hold down the right-click button (the regular context menu still shows if you only click the button). WhimPop gives the option to add favorite apps, folders and URLs on a rail, plus clipboard history, snippets, a timer and much more.
mentions.author: whimbyte
